verdict.rationale: Render documents its own load-based autoscaling that "handles 100x traffic bursts and beyond", and a community user confirms autoscaling support, so the scale-under-load half of the story has some first-party backing. Nothing in the pack addresses instance boot times, and the 100x claim describes traffic multiples rather than tens of thousands of instances. Missing for 10: any evidence of sub-second instance boot, documented scale to tens of thousands of instances, and published autoscaling limits or benchmarks.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can deploy instances that boot in under a second and scale to tens of thousands under load

citations.quote: Load-based autoscaling that handles 100x traffic bursts and beyond
they support distributed Elixir out of the box as well as autoscaling
